title: D60（周四）：结构化输出与校验重试
html:
D60（周四）：结构化输出与校验重试

S3 AI全栈 · W9 · 2小时。前置：D59-Prompt模板与版本管理及前一天面试题。只在验证工程给出参考实现，用户练习代码由你自己手写。

本轮验证环境：Node20.19.6、pnpm10.28.0、TypeScript6.0.3、Vitest4.1.12；具体依赖锁定在当天工程快照的pnpm-lock.yaml。

今天要做出什么

把D59的字段约定落实成shared运行时schema，由它生成JSON Schema发送上游，并在返回时再次验证。JSON语法或业务字段无效最多修复一次；拒绝、截断和协议错误明确失败。模型只产建议，仍不建工单。

今天的目录结构

★ packages/shared/src/triage.ts
★ packages/shared/src/index.ts
★ apps/server/src/assistant/triage-output.ts
★ apps/server/src/assistant/triage.service.ts
★ apps/server/src/assistant/triage-output.spec.ts
★ apps/server/src/assistant/model-policy.ts
★ apps/server/src/assistant/model-completion.ts

★ apps/server/src/assistant/assistant.module.ts

★ 为本章需要手写或修改的文件；新增目录按路径创建。

第四节从验证工程自动读取本章涉及的完整文件。未列出的代码沿用前章；阶段快照保留当天版本。

时间安排（120分钟）

回忆10、知识35、动手55、自检与提交20。到100分钟先砍拓展与选做，保留必做契约和两反证；完整回归等待另计。

零、闭卷回忆

先回答再展开；前三题按昨天、3天前、7天前复习。复测错题本到期项；尚无用户提交，不登记已掌握。

1. 昨天D59：模板hash能代表整次请求吗？

答案

不能，只覆盖system模板；用户材料、模型、参数和schema还有自己的版本边界。

2. 3天前D57：未知模型别名怎么处理？

答案

明确拒绝，不能静默切回default或mock。

3. 7天前D53：虚拟列表减少了所有内存吗？

答案

只减少挂载DOM，消息数组和单条文本仍要设预算。

一、知识点与推导

知识点示例取自当天已通过测试，按TypeScript语法树排版。示例依赖同一测试文件中的导入与夹具，不能单独粘贴执行；先完成第四节对应文件，再在指定目录运行命令。数据库示例沿用隔离测试数据清理范围。

1.1 三层成功条件

HTTP成功不等于JSON合法，JSON合法不等于字段合约通过，字段通过也不等于事实正确。共享schema限定分类/优先级、长度、confidence和缺失信息条数，拒绝groupId等额外字段。

可运行示例：拒绝和截断不会伪装成成功

来源：apps/server/src/assistant/triage-output.spec.ts。以下断言包含具体输入与预期结果，完整夹具见第四节。

it('拒绝和截断不会伪装成成功', () => { expect(() => parseTriageOutput(response('{}', 'stop', 'refused'))).toThrow('MODEL_REFUSED'); expect(() => parseTriageOutput(response(JSON.stringify(suggestion), 'length'))).toThrow('MODEL_TRUNCATED'); });

在apps/server运行：

pnpm test src/assistant/triage-output.spec.ts -t "拒绝和截断不会伪装成成功"

推导题：为什么confidence在0到1仍可能不可信？

答案

它是模型自报值，不是经过校准的真实概率，必须结合证据和人工判断。

1.2 单一schema与供应商能力

用Zod toJSONSchema从本地schema生成上游格式要求，减少两份手写契约漂移。按Structured Outputs文档区分拒绝与结构输出；本项目是兼容接口适配，不假定每个中转站支持所有schema关键字。

可运行示例：接受合法字段且schema禁止额外属性

来源：apps/server/src/assistant/triage-output.spec.ts。以下断言包含具体输入与预期结果，完整夹具见第四节。

it('接受合法字段且schema禁止额外属性', () => { expect(parseTriageOutput(response())).toEqual(suggestion); expect(triageResponseFormat.json_schema.schema.additionalProperties).toBe(false); });

在apps/server运行：

pnpm test src/assistant/triage-output.spec.ts -t "接受合法字段且schema禁止额外属性"

推导题：上游不支持json_schema时自动去掉约束吗？

答案

本章不静默降级；4xx按请求错误失败。必须显式验证供应商能力后再另行设计兼容策略。

1.3 修复只处理可修的内容错误

先校验一个index0候选和终止理由，拒绝为MODEL_REFUSED、length为MODEL_TRUNCATED；完整stop文本再JSON.parse和schema。只有MODEL_INVALID_OUTPUT触发第二次请求，不截取花括号，不把坏输出拼回提示。

可运行示例：一次校验失败后修复成功

来源：apps/server/src/assistant/triage-output.spec.ts。以下断言包含具体输入与预期结果，完整夹具见第四节。

it('一次校验失败后修复成功', async () => {
    configured();
    const gateway = new ModelGateway();
    const spy = vi.spyOn(gateway, 'complete').mockResolvedValueOnce(response('{}')).mockResolvedValueOnce(response());
    const result = await new TriageService(gateway).suggest({ description: '设备离线' });
    expect(result.validationAttempts).toBe(2);
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(spy.mock.calls[1]?.[0].at(-1)?.content).toContain('未通过JSON字段校验');
    if (process.env.D60_EVIDENCE_FILE)
        appendFileSync(process.env.D60_EVIDENCE_FILE, JSON.stringify({ case: 'structured-repair', mode: result.mode, fixture: true, validationAttempts: result.validationAttempts, suggestion: result.suggestion }) + '\n');
});

在apps/server运行：

pnpm test src/assistant/triage-output.spec.ts -t "一次校验失败后修复成功"

推导题：为什么截断不自动修复？

答案

可能仍受输出预算限制，再发同一任务会重复消耗；应提示缩小输入或调整明确预算，不能当语法错误盲重发。

1.4 多层尝试共享预算

外层TriageService只有一个5秒总期限，修复请求传剩余时间给D58网关。每次校验生成最多2次HTTP，因此最坏最多4次HTTP，半开等策略可能更少。mock明确标记、confidence为0且不调用模型。

可运行示例：共享总预算在不合作网关处结束

来源：apps/server/src/assistant/triage-output.spec.ts。以下断言包含具体输入与预期结果，完整夹具见第四节。

it('共享总预算在不合作网关处结束', async () => { configured(); vi.useFakeTimers(); const gateway = new ModelGateway(); vi.spyOn(gateway, 'complete').mockImplementation(() => new Promise(() => { })); const p = new TriageService(gateway).suggest({ description: '故障' }); const check = expect(p).rejects.toThrow('MODEL_TIMEOUT'); await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(5000); await check; expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0); });

在apps/server运行：

pnpm test src/assistant/triage-output.spec.ts -t "共享总预算在不合作网关处结束"

推导题：外层超时是否证明远端停止？

答案

不能；这里只结束本地等待并传播signal。实际计费与远端取消留到真实联调核验。

二、自己动手（必做）

步骤1：定义共享建议契约

提示1：方向

字段只描述建议，不能包含操作者或自动执行权限。

提示2：API与文档位置

triageSuggestionSchema；改shared先pnpm --filter @ops-ticket/shared build。

提示3：伪代码

title/description/category/priority/deviceCode/confidence/missingInformation→strict。

步骤2：写完整返回解析器

提示1：方向

拒绝和截断先于JSON内容解析。

提示2：API与文档位置

parseTriageOutput、triageResponseFormat。

提示3：伪代码

envelope→refusal→finish_reason→JSON.parse整段→schema.safeParse。

步骤3：组装有限修复流程

提示1：方向

一次用户动作共用总期限，不重置5秒。

提示2：API与文档位置

TriageService.suggest、ModelGateway.complete的responseFormat参数。

提示3：伪代码

mock直接schema校验→真实最多两轮→只INVALID_OUTPUT修复→finally清timer/listener。

步骤4：用合成供应商结果验证

提示1：方向

覆盖合法、越权字段、坏JSON、拒绝、截断、重复修复失败和超时。

提示2：API与文档位置

triage-output.spec.ts；所有mode:model样本都是网关桩。

提示3：伪代码

通过→放过额外字段/截断→观察失败→原字节恢复→完整门禁。

四、本章完整源码

4.1 本章源码与测试

packages/shared/src/triage.ts

import { z } from 'zod';

// 模型建议只描述工单，不携带操作者、班组或自动执行权限。
export const triageSuggestionSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(1).max(120),
  description: z.string().min(1).max(4000),
  category: z.enum(['equipment', 'network', 'software', 'other']),
  priority: z.enum(['P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'P4']),
  deviceCode: z.string().min(1).max(64).nullable(),
  confidence: z.number().min(0).max(1),
  missingInformation: z.array(z.string().min(1).max(120)).max(5),
}).strict();
export type TriageSuggestion = z.infer<typeof triageSuggestionSchema>;
export interface TriageResult {
  suggestion: TriageSuggestion;
  mode: 'mock' | 'model';
  promptVersion: string;
  promptHash: string;
  validationAttempts: number;
}

import { z } from 'zod';
import { triageSuggestionSchema, type TriageSuggestion } from '@ops-ticket/shared';
import { GatewayFailure } from './model-policy.js';

export const triageResponseFormat = {
  type: 'json_schema',
  json_schema: { name: 'ticket_triage', strict: true, schema: z.toJSONSchema(triageSuggestionSchema) },
};
const envelope = z.object({ choices: z.array(z.object({
  index: z.literal(0), finish_reason: z.string(),
  message: z.object({ content: z.string().nullable(), refusal: z.string().nullable().optional() }),
})).length(1) });
export function parseTriageOutput(raw: unknown): TriageSuggestion {
  const parsed = envelope.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_PROTOCOL_ERROR');
  const choice = parsed.data.choices[0]!;
  if (choice.message.refusal) throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_REFUSED');
  if (choice.finish_reason === 'length') throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_TRUNCATED');
  if (choice.finish_reason !== 'stop' || choice.message.content === null) throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_PROTOCOL_ERROR');
  let value: unknown;
  try { value = JSON.parse(choice.message.content) as unknown; }
  catch { throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_INVALID_OUTPUT'); }
  const result = triageSuggestionSchema.safeParse(value);
  if (!result.success) throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_INVALID_OUTPUT');
  return result.data;
}

apps/server/src/assistant/triage.service.ts

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { triageSuggestionSchema, type TriageResult } from '@ops-ticket/shared';
import { ModelGateway } from './model-gateway.js';
import { readModelRegistry } from './model-registry.js';
import { buildTriagePrompt, triageInputSchema } from './prompt-catalog.js';
import { GatewayFailure, abortable } from './model-policy.js';
import { parseTriageOutput, triageResponseFormat } from './triage-output.js';

@Injectable()
export class TriageService {
  constructor(private readonly gateway: ModelGateway) {}
  async suggest(input: unknown, parent?: AbortSignal, alias = 'default'): Promise<TriageResult> {
    if(parent?.aborted) throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_CANCELLED');
    const data = triageInputSchema.parse(input);
    const prompt = buildTriagePrompt(data);
    if (!readModelRegistry().resolve(alias)) {
      return { suggestion: triageSuggestionSchema.parse({title: data.description.slice(0,80),description:data.description,category:'other',priority:'P3',deviceCode:data.deviceCode??null,confidence:0,missingInformation:['此为模拟建议，请人工核对。']}), mode:'mock',promptVersion:prompt.version,promptHash:prompt.hash,validationAttempts:0 };
    }
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const cancel = () => controller.abort(new GatewayFailure('MODEL_CANCELLED'));
    parent?.addEventListener('abort',cancel,{once:true});
    const deadline = Date.now() + 5000;
    const timer = setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(new GatewayFailure('MODEL_TIMEOUT',true)),5000);
    try {
      for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
        controller.signal.throwIfAborted();
        const messages = attempt===1 ? prompt.messages : [...prompt.messages,{role:'user' as const,content:'上次输出未通过JSON字段校验。请按原任务和schema重新输出完整JSON，不要Markdown或额外字段。'}];
        const raw = await abortable(this.gateway.complete(messages,controller.signal,alias,Math.max(0,deadline-Date.now()),triageResponseFormat),controller.signal);
        try {
          return {suggestion:parseTriageOutput(raw),mode:'model',promptVersion:prompt.version,promptHash:prompt.hash,validationAttempts:attempt};
        } catch(error) {
          // 只修复JSON语法或业务schema失败；拒绝、截断和协议异常不自动重生成。
          if (!(error instanceof GatewayFailure) || error.code!=='MODEL_INVALID_OUTPUT' || attempt===2) throw error;
        }
      }
      throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_INVALID_OUTPUT');
    } finally { clearTimeout(timer);parent?.removeEventListener('abort',cancel); }
  }
}

// 仅用于无副作用的非流式模型生成；计费仍可能发生，不能保证远端取消。
export type GatewayCode = 'MODEL_BUSY' | 'MODEL_UNAVAILABLE' | 'MODEL_TIMEOUT' | 'MODEL_CANCELLED' | 'MODEL_CONFIG_ERROR' | 'MODEL_REQUEST_ERROR' | 'MODEL_PROTOCOL_ERROR' | 'MODEL_CIRCUIT_OPEN' | 'MODEL_REFUSED' | 'MODEL_TRUNCATED' | 'MODEL_INVALID_OUTPUT';
export class GatewayFailure extends Error {
  constructor(readonly code: GatewayCode, readonly retryable = false) { super(code); }
}
export function statusFailure(status: number): GatewayFailure {
  if (status === 429) return new GatewayFailure('MODEL_BUSY', true);
  if (status === 408 || status === 524) return new GatewayFailure('MODEL_TIMEOUT', true);
  if (status >= 500) return new GatewayFailure('MODEL_UNAVAILABLE', true);
  return new GatewayFailure(status === 401 || status === 403 ? 'MODEL_CONFIG_ERROR' : 'MODEL_REQUEST_ERROR');
}

export function abortable<T>(work: Promise<T>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const aborted = () => reject(signal.reason);
    if (signal.aborted) { work.catch(() => {}); reject(signal.reason); return; }
    signal.addEventListener('abort', aborted, { once: true });
    work.then(resolve, reject).finally(() => signal.removeEventListener('abort', aborted));
  });
}
async function delay(ms: number, signal: AbortSignal) {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  try { await abortable(new Promise<void>(resolve => { timer = setTimeout(resolve, ms); }), signal); }
  finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}

export class ModelPolicy {
  private failures = 0;
  private openedAt: number | null = null;
  private probe = false;
  private epoch = 0;
  constructor(private readonly now = () => Date.now(), private readonly random = () => Math.random()) {}
  async run<T>(work: (signal: AbortSignal, attempt: number) => Promise<T>, parent?: AbortSignal, budgetMs = 5000): Promise<T> {
    if (parent?.aborted) throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_CANCELLED');
    if (!Number.isFinite(budgetMs) || budgetMs <= 0 || budgetMs > 5000) throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_TIMEOUT');
    if (this.openedAt !== null && (this.now() - this.openedAt < 30000 || this.probe)) throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_CIRCUIT_OPEN');
    const halfOpen = this.openedAt !== null;
    if (halfOpen) this.probe = true;
    const epoch = this.epoch;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const cancel = () => controller.abort(new GatewayFailure('MODEL_CANCELLED'));
    parent?.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(new GatewayFailure('MODEL_TIMEOUT', true)), budgetMs);
    try {
      for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
        controller.signal.throwIfAborted();
        try {
          const value = await abortable(Promise.resolve().then(() => work(controller.signal, attempt)), controller.signal);
          if (epoch === this.epoch) { this.failures = 0; this.openedAt = null; }
          return value;
        } catch (error) {
          if (controller.signal.aborted) throw controller.signal.reason;
          if (!(error instanceof GatewayFailure) || !error.retryable || attempt >= 2 || halfOpen) throw error;
          await delay(100 + Math.floor(this.random() * 100), controller.signal);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (epoch === this.epoch && error instanceof GatewayFailure && error.retryable) {
        this.failures++;
        if (halfOpen || this.failures >= 3) { this.openedAt = this.now(); this.epoch++; }
      }
      throw error;
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer); parent?.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
      if (halfOpen) this.probe = false;
    }
  }
}

import type { ModelConfig } from './model.config.js';
import { readLimitedJson, type ChatMessage } from './chat.client.js';
import { GatewayFailure, statusFailure } from './model-policy.js';

// 不复用流式HTTP错误折叠：这里需要区分是否值得重试。
export async function requestCompletion(config: ModelConfig, messages: ChatMessage[], signal: AbortSignal, responseFormat?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
  let response: Response;
  try {
    response = await fetch(config.endpoint, {
      method: 'POST', redirect: 'error', signal,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${config.apiKey}` },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: config.model, messages, stream: false, max_completion_tokens: 512, store: false, ...(responseFormat ? { response_format: responseFormat } : {}) }),
    });
  } catch {
    if (signal.aborted) throw signal.reason;
    throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_UNAVAILABLE', true);
  }
  if (!response.ok) { void response.body?.cancel().catch(() => {}); throw statusFailure(response.status); }
  if (!response.headers.get('content-type')?.includes('application/json')) {
    void response.body?.cancel().catch(() => {}); throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_PROTOCOL_ERROR');
  }
  try { return await readLimitedJson(response); }
  catch { if (signal.aborted) throw signal.reason; throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_PROTOCOL_ERROR'); }
}

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ChatClient, ModelError, type ChatMessage } from './chat.client.js';
import { readModelRegistry } from './model-registry.js';
import { mockStream } from './mock-stream.js';
import { ModelPolicy, GatewayFailure } from './model-policy.js';
import { requestCompletion } from './model-completion.js';

@Injectable()
export class ModelGateway {
  private readonly policies = new Map<string, ModelPolicy>();
  async complete(messages: ChatMessage[], signal?: AbortSignal, alias = 'default', budgetMs = 5000, responseFormat?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
    const registry = readModelRegistry();
    const config = registry.resolve(alias);
    if (!config) throw new GatewayFailure('MODEL_CONFIG_ERROR');
    // 按受控别名保存进程内状态；配置变更需重启，最多8个。
    for (const key of this.policies.keys()) if (!registry.aliases().includes(key)) this.policies.delete(key);
    let policy = this.policies.get(alias);
    if (!policy) { policy = new ModelPolicy(); this.policies.set(alias, policy); }
    return policy.run(child => requestCompletion(config, messages, child, responseFormat), signal, budgetMs);
  }
  async stream(messages: ChatMessage[], signal: AbortSignal, alias = 'default') {
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    const config = readModelRegistry().resolve(alias);
    if (!config) return { body: mockStream(signal), mode: 'mock' as const };
    const response = await new ChatClient(config).open(messages, true, signal);
    if (!response.headers.get('content-type')?.startsWith('text/event-stream') || !response.body) {
      await response.body?.cancel(); throw new ModelError('MODEL_PROTOCOL_ERROR');
    }
    // 本周流式保持W7预算与终止校验；不会在已发正文后重放请求。
    return { body: response.body, mode: 'model' as const };
  }
}

五、核心面试题

  1. JSON模式和严格结构输出有何区别？ 要点：合法JSON只保证语法；schema还约束字段形状与枚举。即便供应商声称严格输出，本地也验证拒绝、截断、字段和业务范围，事实仍需人工确认。
  2. 为什么拒绝和length不是普通JSON解析失败？ 要点：它们有明确生成状态：模型拒绝或预算截断。把它们送入语法修复会丢失原因并增加无效成本，本章不自动重试这两类结果。
  3. 两层重试最多发几次？ 要点：D58一次complete最多2个HTTP尝试；D60最多2轮结构生成，故上限4次且共用5秒总预算。不能把每层次数独立叠加而不算总量。

完整原题、答案、补充和网络来源见D60面试题。
